provider.description: Agent backend provider. Config currently accepts only hermes.
provider.title: Provider

working_dir.description: Agent subprocess working directory; null uses the config file directory.
working_dir.title: Working Dir

config_scope.description: Whether agent CLI calls load user-global configuration or run isolated from it.
config_scope.title: Config Scope

auto_context.description: Whether agent CLI calls auto-load rules, memory, and implicit skill context.
auto_context.title: Auto Context

explicit_context.description: Context explicitly injected by feishu-shadow-agent instead of discovered from user-global state.

name.description: Human-readable chat name for operators; not used as an identifier.
name.title: Name

auto_reply.description: Whether this chat may auto-reply when all gates pass.
auto_reply.title: Auto Reply

bot_joined.description: Whether the bot has joined this chat and can be used for bot replies and resource access.
bot_joined.title: Bot Joined

reply_identity.description: Reply identity for this chat: prefer bot with fallback, require bot, or send as user.
reply_identity.title: Reply Identity

allow_user_fallback.description: Whether group replies may fall back to user identity when bot_preferred cannot use the bot.
allow_user_fallback.title: Allow User Fallback

resource_download.description: Whether downloadable message resources may be saved for this chat.
resource_download.title: Resource Download

overlap_seconds.description: Look-back window added to message fetches so delayed Feishu results are not missed.
overlap_seconds.title: Overlap Seconds

save_full_agent_io.description: Whether to persist full agent prompts and outputs for debugging; keep false for normal operation.
save_full_agent_io.title: Save Full Agent Io

skills.description: Explicit skill directory paths or SKILL.md file paths to pass only to task-session agent turns.
skills.title: Skills

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between full runtime health refreshes.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

retry_interval_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying runtime health after a critical failure.
retry_interval_seconds.title: Retry Interval Seconds

timeout_seconds.description: Default timeout in seconds for health probes.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

mode.description: Hermes health mode. Runtime task processing always uses the local Hermes CLI; 'http' adds a health URL check.
mode.title: Mode

path.description: Optional Hermes executable path for cli mode; null uses the current PATH.
path.title: Path

source.description: Source label passed to Hermes sessions and audit data.
source.title: Source

router_max_turns.description: Maximum Hermes turns for task routing calls.
router_max_turns.title: Router Max Turns

session_max_turns.description: Maximum Hermes turns for task session calls.
session_max_turns.title: Session Max Turns

model.description: Optional Hermes model override; null uses the Hermes default.
model.title: Model

provider.description: Optional Hermes provider override; null uses the Hermes default.
provider.title: Provider

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for Hermes subprocess or health calls.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

health_url.description: Additional HTTP health URL used when agent_backend.hermes.mode is 'http'; must start with http:// or https://.
health_url.title: Health Url

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name that holds the Hermes API key for agent_backend.hermes.mode http; the secret value is never stored here.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

path.description: Optional lark-cli executable path; null uses the current PATH.
path.title: Path

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for lark-cli subprocess calls.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

watch_minutes.description: Minutes to keep watching a task after activity.
watch_minutes.title: Watch Minutes

burst_attach_seconds.description: Seconds in which trigger messages from the same sender and chat can attach to the same active task without calling the task router; 0 disables this shortcut.
burst_attach_seconds.title: Burst Attach Seconds

closed_recall_days.description: Days to consider closed tasks for explicit recall.
closed_recall_days.title: Closed Recall Days

approval_timeout_hours.description: Hours before pending approvals expire; null means approvals never expire.
approval_timeout_hours.title: Approval Timeout Hours

jsonl_path.description: JSONL log path, resolved relative to the config file when not absolute.
jsonl_path.title: Jsonl Path

level.description: Minimum runtime log level written to configured sinks.
level.title: Level

console.description: Whether to also write human-readable runtime logs to stderr.
console.title: Console

text_path.description: Optional human-readable log file path, resolved relative to the config file when not absolute.
text_path.title: Text Path

open_id.description: Feishu open_id of the single owner who receives approval notifications and can run local commands.
open_id.title: Open Id

name.description: Optional display name for humans reading config and logs.
name.title: Name

lookback_days.description: Days of owner replies to sample for style refresh.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

max_samples.description: Maximum filtered owner reply samples to summarize.
max_samples.title: Max Samples

min_samples.description: Minimum filtered samples required before writing a profile.
min_samples.title: Min Samples

p2p_auto_reply.description: Whether one-to-one chats may auto-reply when reply gates pass.
p2p_auto_reply.title: P2P Auto Reply

unknown_group_auto_reply.description: Whether groups without an explicit chats entry may auto-reply when all gates pass.
unknown_group_auto_reply.title: Unknown Group Auto Reply

enabled.description: Whether agent-generated reply candidates are postprocessed.
enabled.title: Enabled

max_turns.description: Maximum Hermes turns for one-shot reply postprocess calls.
max_turns.title: Max Turns

model.description: Optional model override; null inherits agent_backend.hermes.model.
model.title: Model

provider.description: Optional provider override; null inherits agent_backend.hermes.provider.
provider.title: Provider

enabled.description: Whether to use the humanizer-zh guidance skill.
enabled.title: Enabled

skill_path.description: Path to the humanizer-zh SKILL.md guidance file.
skill_path.title: Skill Path

enabled.description: Whether to use the owner style profile during reply postprocess.
enabled.title: Enabled

profile_path.description: Markdown owner style profile path, resolved relative to config.yaml when not absolute.
profile_path.title: Profile Path

raw_message_days.description: Days to retain raw message payloads.
raw_message_days.title: Raw Message Days

resource_days.description: Days to retain downloaded resource files.
resource_days.title: Resource Days

sqlite_path.description: SQLite database path, resolved relative to the config file when not absolute.
sqlite_path.title: Sqlite Path

resource_dir.description: Safe relative directory for downloaded message resources; absolute paths and '..' are rejected.
resource_dir.title: Resource Dir

max_resource_bytes.description: Maximum bytes allowed for one downloaded message resource.
max_resource_bytes.title: Max Resource Bytes

max_resource_dir_bytes.description: Maximum total bytes allowed under the downloaded resource directory.
max_resource_dir_bytes.title: Max Resource Dir Bytes

owner.description: Single owner identity used for approvals and operator notifications.

health.description: Runtime health refresh and timeout settings.

storage.description: Local SQLite and resource storage settings.

agent_backend.description: Agent backend provider, isolation policy, explicit context, and provider-specific settings.

reply_policy.description: Global auto-reply policy used before chat-specific overrides.

reply_postprocess.description: Optional one-shot postprocess for agent-generated reply candidates.

chats.description: Per-chat policy overrides keyed by Feishu chat_id, such as oc_xxx.
chats.title: Chats

tool_permissions.description: Agent backend tool permission profile: read_only or full_access.
tool_permissions.title: Tool Permissions
